title: Model choices get a reshuffle
summary:
Model mappings changed, tier-aware tracking moved into Enter, and the registry got less willing to guess what a request meant.

`openai-large` was switched to GPT-5 Chat and its 20,000-character input cap was removed. The OpenAI text service defaults changed, Kontext returned to the seed-tier image configuration, and the image registry gained `gptimage` aliases. Text model aliases now come from the shared registry.

Enter added a tier to user records and auth sessions. Generation tracking now reads the authenticated user's tier and passes it to generation backends, rather than relying on response data. This does not add tier-based usage enforcement.

The docs clarify that GPT-5 accepts only the default temperature of 1 and does not support `top_p`. They also add guidance for verbatim TTS output and a warning about requesting system prompts from reasoning models.

highlights.title: GPT-5 Chat for openai-large
highlights.text: `openai-large` is configured for `gpt-5-chat-latest` instead of GPT-4.1, and its former 20,000-character input cap was removed. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=openai-large).

highlights.title: Kontext returns to images
highlights.text: Kontext is back in the seed-tier image model configuration, with a 1216-pixel maximum side length. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=kontext).
